notes: Studio architecture upgrade, step 3: the real product outline instead of the image rectangle.

Cutouts carry a transparent margin, so occlusion judged from the full rectangle was wrong. The product alpha is now scanned once to find the true content box, and layerBounds() returns that box for product layers.
Occlusion checks, text-on-product checks, the audit score and the auto-repair all now use the real outline.
